original_ai_output.title_zh: 喀麦隆女性被杀案频发，家属要求伸张正义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 喀麦隆性别暴力事件持续增加，今年以来已有至少56名女性被杀，民众愤怒情绪不断上升。妇女部上月宣布，一项将杀害女性单独列为罪行的法案将在议会11月会期审议。一名喀麦隆教师的家属要求为其遇害母亲伸张正义，其丈夫被列为头号嫌疑人。

key_facts.fact: 喀麦隆今年以来已有至少56名女性被杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Anger is growing in Cameroon over rising gender-based violence that has seen at least 56 women killed since the start of the year.

key_facts.fact: 一项将杀害女性单独列为罪行的法案将在议会11月会期审议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a bill to make femicide a separate crime from murder will be considered during parliament's November session after gaining widespread support

key_facts.fact: 一名喀麦隆教师被殴打致死，其丈夫被列为头号嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: his mother Cameroonian teacher Geraldine Achia was beaten to death, with her husband the prime suspect
